images.name: spritzer
images.build: { docker buildx inspect chant-release >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker buildx create --name chant-release --driver docker-container >/dev/null; } && mkdir -p build/images && docker buildx build --builder chant-release --no-cache --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --provenance=false --sbom=false --build-arg SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --build-arg VERSION="$CHANT_RELEASE_LABEL" --output type=oci,dest=build/images/spritzer.tar,rewrite-timestamp=true -f Dockerfile . >&2
